actions.description: Callback action for the on poll ingest functionality
actions.verbose: Retrieves the emails of the Cofense Vision AI clusters ingested in the polling window and creates a container for every cluster along with an artifact for every email of that cluster. A cluster keeps growing as new emails join it, so it is returned again by every polling window that ingests one of its emails. Only the emails of the window are ingested, into containers identified by the ingestion timestamp of the newest email they hold. Scheduled polling windows never overlap, so every email is ingested once and a scheduled poll never adds artifacts to a container created by an earlier scheduled poll. POLL NOW is meant for sampling: it neither reads nor updates the polling checkpoint, so its window can overlap the windows of other polls. A poll whose window overlaps an earlier POLL NOW, whether another POLL NOW or a scheduled poll, can add older emails to a container that POLL NOW created, and repeating POLL NOW over a cluster that is still receiving emails ingests those emails again into new containers. No email is lost in either case. To avoid both, delete the containers created by POLL NOW before scheduled polling covers the same period. Every container is named after its cluster ID, the cluster title and the ingestion timestamp of the oldest email it holds, so every email of the container was ingested at or after that time, for example '291 : Invoice campaign - 2024-05-31T10:00:00Z'; the polling window is stated in the container description. The emails of a cluster are split across containers of at most 'Maximum number of artifacts in a single container' artifacts each, so a cluster of 200 emails with the default limit of 100 produces 2 containers. Those containers are named with their part, for example '... - Part 1 of 2'. The polling window ends 'Ingestion lag' minutes (5 by default) before the current time, so that an email whose row is committed after its ingestion timestamp is still picked up by the next cycle; an email committed later than the lag is never ingested. The polling window starts at the 'Start Time' asset configuration parameter for the first scheduled or interval poll and at the end of the previous polling window for the subsequent ones. The 'Start Time for Poll Now' asset configuration parameter is used for the manual POLL NOW runs; the start_time and end_time that Splunk SOAR passes to the action are ignored. POLL NOW stops exactly at its container_count and artifact_count, even within a cluster. Both parameters accept a relative time, for example 1d, 6h, 30m, or an absolute UTC date, for example 2024-05-31T00:00:00Z. A scheduled poll ingests every email of every cluster returned for its window; there is no limit on the number of emails in a cycle.

container_count.description: Maximum number of containers to create during POLL NOW

artifact_count.description: Maximum number of artifacts to create during POLL NOW
